messages:
maria: FYI PR #5123 (routing + kv-cache changes) is blocked on arch review before merge. RFC posted: https://redwood/research/rfcs/2026-storage-sharding. TL;DR: changes to routing policy + kernel selection hints. Needs arch signoff because it touches runtime kernel selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5123

todd: pinging @liz and @arch-team for review — is this still blocking release? :eyes:

liz: I'll take a look this afternoon. can you highlight the exact lines that change kernel selection?

maria: snippet:
```diff
- if (model->seq_len < 1024) use_kernel(A);
+ if (workload_hint == SHARDED) use_kernel(B);
```
Also toggles route->variant in runtime config (runtime/config/routes.yaml).

liz: ok that change is sensitive. I'll review the RFC + PR together. if we need an opt-in rollout flag, we should add it to the PR (canary first).

priya: recommend gating the merge behind RFC acceptance. ops wants a canary plan and clear rollback. :+1:

maria: agree. I added `gated_on_rfc: true` to the PR description and disabled auto-merge. left the proposed canary plan in PR comments.

liz: quick note — if we introduce kernel B we need perf numbers. can you attach 99th/median latency from your smoke runs?

maria: uploaded logs to the PR under /artifacts/sharded-smoke. sample numbers: median 12ms -> 11ms, p99 240ms -> 260ms under sharded. full logs linked in PR.

liz: thanks. I'll post formal review comments in the PR and mark arch-approved or arch-needs-changes based on perf/regressions. ETA for signoff: EOD today unless blockers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

todd: thanks all. if arch signs off, can we merge tomorrow morning during low traffic window? ops: any objections?

deploy-bot: Scheduled merge window check: low traffic window 03:00 UTC available.

maria: yes, merge tomorrow 03:00 UTC if arch-approved.

liz: noted. I'll set approval + include canary tag in the rollout policy and leave a follow-up comment with required perf thresholds.

priya: adding a note — please document rollback steps in the PR description (how to revert route variant + kv-cache config).

maria: done, added rollback steps and a quick runbook snippet. thanks everyone. :rocket:
